evidence.description: Read-only GET /load_auto_pid of the original Prius (.204) captured around the v1.1.0-rc.3 install (pre/ and post/ identical)

provenance.classification_basis: VehicleHub edc5ffa4: packages/shared/src/validation.ts sanitizeSample aliases (canonical), prius-wican-candidates.ts (raw-only candidates, optional)
notes: Evidence is the original Prius (.204), which runs the configured_activity_signal READY provider (21C4 B12, parameter_id ready.activity.v1). The second Prius (.52, 2026-10-10 AutoPID backup) uses a different group layout (Diagnostics 30 s, Readiness 60 s, Engine and Cruise Control 1 s, 21C3+21C4 merged) and an unconfirmed READY active_value; it is not used as evidence.

probe_b10..probe_b24 (21C3), the disabled 7C0 Odometer group (2101 ODOM) and the TEST PDF 7E0 on-demand group are reverse-engineering probes and test groups (Prius_AutoPID_table.md notes). They are experimental: rendered disabled unless the user enables them as a local override.

The experimental groups keep their device topics verbatim (both used the editor's default 'new-group' slug), so enabling them publishes to <base>/autopid/group/new-group and wican/device/autopid/group/new-group exactly as before.

Hybrid battery, hybrid ECU and motor fields are VehicleHub raw-only candidates (PRIUS_WICAN_CANDIDATE_FIELDS: recognition is not validation; resistance unit, current polarity and flag bits are unverified).
Cruise Control (21D3), Engine (21CD/21F3) and standard 01/41 readiness are published by the device but not mapped by VehicleHub; they are optional.
DTC PermanentDTC (0A) is disabled on the device and stays disabled by default.
send_to values on MQTT_Grp parameters (priushv, pr) are ignored by the firmware (MQTT_Grp publishes to the group topic) and are not carried in the profile.
The three flat car-level PIDs on the device (015B2 SOC, 01A61 ODOMETER, 01317 OILCH_DIS) are inert (car_specific disabled, not in any group) and unverified; the profile does not own or change them.
The 0x5A4 passive CAN rule on .204 is an unvalidated candidate (VEHICLEHUB-1099); it is not part of this profile.
system_main_relay_flags is the firmware READY activity signal; its PID, group and parameter are locked so the vehicle_state descriptor always resolves.
